# EC Chess Academy HK (卓思棋院)

> Hong Kong's Premier Chess & Strategy Training Academy

## Overview
EC Chess Academy HK is a leading chess and cognitive strategy academy based in Hong Kong. We provide elite FIDE-certified instruction in International Chess, Chinese Chess (Xiangqi), and Go (Weiqi) for children and youth aged 3.5 to 18+.

## Core Programs
- **International Chess (國際象棋)**: FIDE-standard foundational and tournament master classes. Focuses on spatial calculations, dynamic calculation, tactical motifs, and FIDE ratings.
- **Chinese Chess / Xiangqi (中國象棋)**: Traditional tactical reasoning, piece coordination, and attack-defense balance.
- **Go / Weiqi (圍棋)**: Macro board evaluation, territory management, and multi-step foresight.

## Coaching & Credentials
- Official FIDE (International Chess Federation) certified instructors.
- Hong Kong National Team representatives and National Master coaches.
- 15+ years of elite coaching experience helping students gain admission into top Hong Kong and international schools.
